$comment: Yarn requirement model v0.1 — see spec/yarn.md. Read by app/src/core/yarn and lab/src/crolab/yarn.py. Every number here is a NOMINAL default, unvalidated against measured yarn: the structural coefficients are derived from how each stitch is built (spec/yarn.md §2), the category table holds typical retail values. A weighed swatch (calibration) replaces the guesswork for one yarn and one crocheter.

ch.why: one loop pulled through the loop on the hook: two strands the length of the chain, one 180° turn round the old loop

slst.why: loop pulled through the base and straight through the loop on the hook: a (short) post of two strands, the top loop, two turns (round the base, round the hook)

sc.why: insert, yo + pull up (two strands up the post), yo + pull through 2 (top loop, two strands across): three turns

hdc.why: as sc plus one yarn-over wrapped round the post (2 strands over about half the height) and one more turn

dc.why: post in two stages: working loop 2 strands over the full height, the wrap 2 strands over half; yo, insert, pull up, 2 × pull through 2

puff.why: per loop: yo, insert, pull up (an hdc leg without its finishing pull-through: 3 height strands, 3 turns); then one closing pull-through and the top loop

popcorn.why: N complete dc (with the dc's own size) + closing: the dropped loop pulled across the popcorn's width once, one turn

picot.why: its chains (ch's size) + the slip stitch that closes it

tog.why: decrease or cluster with N legs of base stitch X: each leg is X without its final pull-through, then one closing pull-through and one top loop

post_factor.why: front/back post: the pulled-up loop goes round the whole post of the stitch below instead of under its two top loops (girth ≈ the post's width instead of ≈ 2 strands). +20 % is a guess, not measured.

nominal.why: ±20 %: gauge spread between crocheters on the same yarn and hook (CYC gauge ranges ≈ ±12 % in stitch size; yarn per stitch scales with loop size) combined with unvalidated coefficients

calibrated.why: ±8 %: one weighed swatch — scale resolution, tension drift over a project, a stitch mix that differs from the swatch

calibrated_split.why: ±6 %: two swatches of different stitches fix the loop and height terms separately

diameter_rule: d = diameter_mm(category) · sqrt(m_per_100g(category) / m_per_100g(your yarn)) — same fibre and construction assumed (constant effective density), so a lighter yarn of the same category is proportionally thinner
